changes.name: GrasslandsEggGameplay
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local egg=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("GrasslandsEgg"):WaitForChild("Egg")
local prompt=egg:WaitForChild("HatchPrompt")
local pets={{name="Cloud Bunny",weight=55,color=Color3.fromRGB(235,245,255)},{name="Sky Fox",weight=30,color=Color3.fromRGB(110,210,255)},{name="Sun Cub",weight=12,color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,70)},{name="Storm Dragon",weight=3,color=Color3.fromRGB(145,95,255)}}
local function roll() local r=math.random(100) local t=0 for _,p in ipairs(pets) do t+=p.weight if r<=t then return p end end return pets[1] end
local function follow(plr,p)
 local root=plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root then return end
 local m=Instance.new("Part");m.Name=plr.Name.."_Pet";m.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;m.Size=Vector3.new(3,3,3);m.Color=p.color;m.CanCollide=false;m.Massless=true;m.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(4,1,3);m.Parent=workspace
 local g=Instance.new("BillboardGui");g.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(150,45);g.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0);g.AlwaysOnTop=true;g.Parent=m
 local l=Instance.new("TextLabel");l.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);l.BackgroundTransparency=1;l.Text=p.name;l.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);l.TextScaled=true;l.Parent=g
 local a0=Instance.new("Attachment");a0.Position=Vector3.new(4,1,3);a0.Parent=root local a1=Instance.new("Attachment");a1.Parent=m
 local ap=Instance.new("AlignPosition");ap.Attachment0=a1;ap.Attachment1=a0;ap.MaxForce=50000;ap.Responsiveness=18;ap.Parent=m
end
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
 local stats=plr:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins") if not coins or coins.Value<10 then return end
 coins.Value-=10 local p=roll() local folder=plr:FindFirstChild("Pets") if not folder then folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="Pets";folder.Parent=plr end
 local owned=Instance.new("StringValue");owned.Name=p.name;owned.Value=p.name;owned.Parent=folder
 local old=workspace:FindFirstChild(plr.Name.."_Pet") if old then old:Destroy() end follow(plr,p)
end)
